title: Composed supervisory control: Redundant analog sensor selection -> Clamped analog scaling with range status

inputs.name: B_Raw
inputs.description: Subsystem B: Raw input nominally 0 through 4095

outputs.name: A_Degraded
outputs.description: Subsystem A: Only one sensor valid

outputs.name: A_Disagree
outputs.description: Subsystem A: Both valid but disagree

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: MaxDifference is non-negative and constant during a test.
Selected initializes to 0.0 in a fresh instance.
Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Subsystem A executes before the supervisory latch and subsystem B within each scan.
Requirements inherited from subsystem B apply only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE.
When subsystem B is isolated, its externally visible outputs take their type-safe defaults.

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: When both sensors are valid and agree within A_MaxDifference, A_Selected shall be their average.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: When both sensors are valid but A_Disagree beyond A_MaxDifference, A_Disagree shall be TRUE and A_Selected shall retain its previous value.
requirements.property: G((A_ValidA AND A_ValidB AND ABS(A_SensorA-A_SensorB)>A_MaxDifference) -> (A_Disagree AND A_Selected=prev(A_Selected)))

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: When exactly one sensor is valid, A_Selected shall use that sensor and A_Degraded shall be TRUE.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: When neither sensor is valid, A_NoValidSensor shall be TRUE and A_Selected shall retain its previous value.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Degraded, A_Disagree, and A_NoValidSensor shall be mutually exclusive.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Raw below zero shall set B_UnderRange, clear B_OverRange, and clamp B_Engineering to 0.0.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Raw above 4095 shall set B_OverRange, clear B_UnderRange, and clamp B_Engineering to 10.0.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: In-range B_Raw shall clear both flags and scale linearly to 0.0 through 10.0.
A TRUE A_Degraded shall latch CrossReady unless CrossReset is TRUE in the same scan.
CrossReset shall have priority, clear CrossReady, and isolate every subsystem-B output to its type-safe default.
Once set, CrossReady shall remain TRUE after the subsystem-A signal falls, until a later CrossReset scan.
Subsystem B may execute only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE; CrossBlocked is TRUE exactly when SubsystemBEnable is requested without CrossReady.

provenance.origin: deterministic ordered composition of independently specified base behaviors
